fato_historico: 1868: The 14th Amendment to the United States Constitution is certified, establishing African American citizenship and guaranteeing due process of law.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound sense of justice and belonging to your spirit, Pisces. Much like the historic foundation of equal rights and citizenship, consider how you can build a more inclusive space within your own heart. It is a good time to advocate for your own needs while remaining deeply empathetic toward the collective human experience.
frase_do_dia: Equality is the sunlight that allows every unique soul to bloom in harmony.
significado_numero: Represents the structural foundation of your personal freedom and civic duty.
conselho: Stand firm in your truth and honor the rights of those around you.
